title: For the Seahawks this year, Drew Lock's numbers blow Sam Darnold's away

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: For the Seahawks this year, Drew Lock's numbers blow Sam Darnold's away
sources.description: When Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald confirmed that Sam Darnold will start in Week 12 against the 49ers, assuming he is medically cleared, it was no surprise: The Seahawks signed Darnold to a three-year, $100 million contract last year and won the Super Bowl with Darnold at the helm.
